ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deep Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the role of state officials in allowing it to happen.
questions: What was the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What role did state officials play in allowing the fraud to happen?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread corruption and fraud in the state government. It could also lead to accountability for those responsible.
